summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — CCH.L +3%, MRO.L +2%, BNZL.L +2%, CRDA.L +2%, MTLN.L +2%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (ASM.AS -4%, AAL.L -3%, STLAP.PA -3%, SIE.DE -3%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: ASM.AS (-4.29%) — no obvious news catalyst found for 2026-11-17 — likely a sector-wide semicap/AI-chip selloff (ASM is a high-beta semiconductor equipment name); no company-specific news confirmed. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: ASM.AS is a large-cap Dutch semicap name that no strategy's universe includes. A -4.3% move with no earnings or M&A trigger also gives a news-reactive bot nothing to act on.
